map.输入环境温度、目标发射率、检测距离等，估算红外热像仪最小可分辨温差（MRTD）与: Enter ambient temperature, target emissivity, detection distance and so on to estimate a thermal camera minimum resolvable temperature difference (MRTD) and the measurement error from emissivity.
map.基于红外热像温度反演：大气透过率 τ 随距离指数衰减；最小可分辨温差 MRTD: Based on infrared thermal-image temperature inversion: atmospheric transmittance tau decays exponentially with distance; MRTD is inferred from noise-equivalent temperature difference NETD and signal-to-noise ratio SNR; emissivity error delta T is determined by target emissivity epsilon and target temperature difference, for thermal-imaging temperature correction.
map.💡 公式：大气透过率 τ=e^(−α·d)，α≈0.00005/m；MRTD ≈: Tip: formula: atmospheric transmittance tau = e^(-alpha times d), alpha about 0.00005 / m; MRTD about NETD times SNR times e^(alpha times d), SNR about 2.7; emissivity error delta T about (1 minus epsilon) / epsilon times delta T target.
map.发射率对测温影响显著，低发射率表面需贴黑胶或涂黑处理: Emissivity strongly affects temperature measurement; low-emissivity surfaces need black tape or blackening
map.大气衰减在近距离可忽略，远距离（>100m）需修正: Atmospheric attenuation is negligible at close range, needs correction beyond 100 m
map.MRTD 为系统温度分辨能力，实际还受镜头与算法影响: MRTD is the system temperature-resolution capability; actual also affected by lens and algorithm
map.📚 深度解析：热成像温差判读（MRTD 与发射率误差）: In-depth: Thermal Imaging Temperature-Difference Interpretation (MRTD and emissivity error)
map.检测能力评估：算最小可分辨温差，判断能否识别目标温差: Detection-capability assessment: compute MRTD to judge whether the target temperature difference can be resolved
map.测温误差修正：把发射率引起的偏差量化出来: Measurement-error correction: quantify the deviation caused by emissivity
map.现场方案优化：评估缩短检测距离对分辨力的改善: On-site scheme optimization: assess the resolution improvement from shortening detection distance
map.算法：大气消光系数 α=0.00005/m；大气透过率 τ = e^(−α×距离: Algorithm: atmospheric extinction coefficient alpha = 0.00005 / m; atmospheric transmittance tau = e^(-alpha times distance); MRTD = (NETD / 1000) times 2.7 / tau (K), times 1000 shown as mK; emissivity measurement error = ((1 minus epsilon) / epsilon) times true temperature difference (°C); apparent temperature difference = true difference minus error. Interpretation hints: epsilon below 0.6 warns low emissivity; MRTD below 100 mK excellent resolution, below 300 mK ordinary, otherwise suggest shortening distance.
map.例：ε=0.95、距离 10m、NETD 50mK、真实温差 5℃ → 大气透过: Example: epsilon 0.95, distance 10 m, NETD 50 mK, true difference 5 °C gives atmospheric transmittance 99.95 percent, MRTD 135.1 mK, emissivity error 0.26 °C, apparent difference 4.74 °C, judged as ordinary temperature resolution. If epsilon 0.5, distance 50 m, NETD 30 mK, true difference 10 °C gives transmittance 99.75 percent, MRTD 81.2 mK (better resolution), but emissivity error up to 10.00 °C, apparent difference only 0.00 °C, hint as low emissivity, suggest surface treatment before measuring.
map.为什么发射率低会导致温差测不出来？: Why does low emissivity make the temperature difference unreadable?
map.低发射率表面会反射环境辐射，热像仪接收到的是\"自身辐射 + 反射辐射\"的混合: Low-emissivity surfaces reflect ambient radiation; the camera receives a mix of self-radiation plus reflected radiation, diluting the target temperature difference. Error is about ((1 minus epsilon) / epsilon) times delta T; as epsilon drops from 0.95 to 0.5 the error grows about 38 times, which is why bright metal surfaces must be treated before measurement.
map.现场怎么处理低发射率表面？: How to treat low-emissivity surfaces on site?
map.可贴电工胶带、涂哑光漆或喷专用增黑剂（发射率约 0.95）后再测，并在仪器中同步: Apply electrical tape, matte paint or a dedicated blackening agent (emissivity about 0.95) before measuring, and set the corresponding emissivity and reflected-temperature compensation in the instrument; bright surfaces like stainless steel, aluminum foil and copper busbars must be treated.
map.红外热成像温差判读工具，综合环境温度、目标发射率、检测距离与热像仪 NETD，估: The infrared thermal-imaging temperature-difference interpretation tool integrates ambient temperature, target emissivity, detection distance and camera NETD to estimate the minimum resolvable temperature difference MRTD and the temperature-measurement error from emissivity, aiding infrared inspection interpretation.
